behaviors.search-assignees: Searching the Assignee dropdown narrows its choices to matching people.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting a person shows only tasks assigned to them.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows only tasks without an assignee.
behaviors.combine-filters: Choosing a status and an assignee shows only tasks matching both.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Selecting Ana Lima shows the message “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” and a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters resets both filters and restores the full task list.
